admin.title: AI settings
admin.description: Switch AI on, choose how sensitive insights are, set a monthly budget and manage the assistant's index.
admin.enabledHint: Explanations, report drafts and the assistant call the AI provider. Insights and suggestions are computed by the platform and work either way.
admin.sensitivityHint: How unusual a day has to be before it's flagged.
admin.autoDraftHint: Scheduled report drafts get AI-written commentary and next steps. They stay drafts until someone publishes them.
admin.budgetHint: AI calls stop for the rest of the month when the agency reaches it.

modeHint.mock: A built-in demo provider writes from the platform's own numbers and records. No data leaves the platform.
modeHint.off: Add the missing keys to the environment to use AI.
